The act of mortgaging to bank using the real house (maybe using the real deed) but forging a fake deed to give to Ma. Could be "诈骗" because he obtained loan from bank using the house as collateral, but that is not described as fraudulent to bank; he used the real house as collateral, not fake. The fake deed was given to Ma to hide the fact that he had mortgaged to bank. That could be "诈骗" of Ma (defrauding Ma of his security interest). However the fact says "伪造了假的房产证交还给马某某". So the crime is forging a certificate. The prosecution says "伪造国家机关证件罪". So we list that.
